Re-running test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh in isolation afterward showed only the pre-existing (Phase-1-baselined) skill_cleanup temp-file failure -- 17 passed, 1 failed, matching baseline exactly. The transient extra failures are attributed to a concurrent sibling session (visible in git log as 'task 62' and 'task 77' commits interleaving with this task's own commits) actively writing to specs/ and to files test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh's fixture construction touches, during the same run-all.sh invocation. Not caused by this task's edits; not reproducible in isolation.
